scientific_integrity: Original formulas and full-order joint CLT proved analytically; finite rational enumeration independently checks the identities and forward shuffle coupling. The review reported here is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed two-packet probability strictly between 0 and 1, one forward shuffle, and fixed-bias joint CLT; no endpoint or varying-bias CLT. Finite exact verification does not establish infinite-sample theorems. Potential implicit coverage by broader joint word-statistic generating functions, particularly Thiel (2013), remains a documented priority risk.
title: A spatial descent–inversion sign transition and joint Gaussian law for biased two-packet riffle shuffles
